name.zh: Rhenium Garry's Mod 服务端系统题（五题正式版）

description.en: Five server-authoritative clean-room GMod tasks for Sandbox on gm_flatgrass.
description.zh: 面向 Sandbox/gm_flatgrass 的服务端权威 clean-room GMod 五题。

summary.en: Persist named authoritative weapon and ammo profiles.
summary.zh: 持久化命名的服务端权威武器与弹药配置。

brief.en: Restore canonical loadouts across death, respawn, disconnect and restart.
brief.zh: 跨死亡、重生、断线和重启恢复规范 loadout。

en: [T3-DATA-04] Enforce Pistol 200, SMG1 120, and Buckshot 32 aggregate caps.
[T3-SEM-01] Limit each player to five profiles and four unique weapons per profile.
[T3-SEM-02] Preserve primary/secondary ammo while producing sorted merged plans.
[T3-SEM-04] Deduplicate put/select requests and reject stale revisions.
[T3-PERSIST-02] Persist profiles, preference, revisions, time, and replay.
[T3-ROLLBACK-01] Stop Apply at the first failed phase.
[T3-LIFE-01] Preserve profiles across disconnect and clean lifecycle state on shutdown.
zh: [T3-DATA-03] 强制封闭的四种武器 allowlist。
[T3-DATA-04] 强制 Pistol 200、SMG1 120、Buckshot 32 的聚合上限。
[T3-SEM-01] 每玩家最多五个 profile，每 profile 最多四把不同武器。
[T3-SEM-02] 保留 primary/secondary 弹药并生成排序合并计划。
[T3-SEM-04] 去重 put/select 请求并拒绝旧 revision。
[T3-PERSIST-02] 持久化 profile、偏好、revision、时间与重放。
[T3-ROLLBACK-01] Apply 在第一个失败阶段立即停止。
[T3-LIFE-01] 断线保留 profile，Shutdown 清理生命周期状态。

en: [T3-NATIVE-03] Remove all ammunition before granting the canonical plan.
[T3-NATIVE-04] Give sorted weapons and merged ammo through Player APIs.
[T3-NATIVE-05] Select the first successfully granted weapon.
[T3-NATIVE-02] Restore through real PlayerSpawn and paired lifecycle Hooks.
zh: [T3-NATIVE-04] 通过 Player API 发放排序武器与合并弹药。
[T3-NATIVE-05] 选择第一把成功发放的武器。
[T3-NATIVE-02] 通过真实 PlayerSpawn 与成对生命周期 Hook 恢复。

en: Profile limits, closed allowlists, and exact ammo caps are enforced.
Primary and secondary ammo merge once into detached sorted plans.
Replay, revisions, disconnect, and two-process persistence remain stable.
Real Bot spawn restores weapons and canonical ammunition.
Partial Give stops before ammo and shutdown leaves no lifecycle residue.
zh: Profile 限制、封闭 allowlist 与精确弹药上限均被强制。
Primary/secondary 弹药只合并一次并形成 detached 排序计划。
重放、revision、断线与两进程持久化保持稳定。
真实 Bot 重生恢复武器与规范弹药。
部分 Give 失败会在发弹前停止，关闭后无生命周期残留。
